metadata.name: breezepocket
metadata.description: breezepocket: commit to sell or buy SOL at a fixed price by an expiry, earn yield upfront

instructions.name: emergency_cancel
docs: 3/5 governance: return all collateral immediately, ignoring expiry and price.

accounts.name: position_usdc_vault
docs: USDC associated token account, so a settled position whose vault was closed
reports `AlreadySettled` rather than a deserialization error.

instructions.name: emergency_cancel_asset_position
docs: 3/5 governance: return both legs of a listed-asset position immediately.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the fee and, if needed, rent for missing token accounts.

accounts.name: position_asset_vault
docs: after the `settled` guard.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: One-time setup of the governance list, price poster and USDC mint.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint used by every position on this deployment.

instructions.name: list_asset
docs: 3/5 governance: make an SPL token tradable against USDC.

instructions.name: open_asset_position
docs: `open_position` for a listed asset. Same params; `SellSol` sells the asset,
`BuySol` buys it.

accounts.name: market_maker
docs: Fee payer, rent payer, co-signer, and source of MM collateral and yield.

accounts.name: position_asset_vault
docs: Holds the asset leg until settlement.

accounts.name: position_usdc_vault
docs: Holds the USDC leg until settlement.

accounts.name: user_asset_ata
docs: Created by the market maker if missing so both legs can always be paid out.

instructions.name: open_position
docs: Lock user collateral and the market maker's counter-leg atomically and pay
the yield to the user upfront. Requires both the user and MM signatures;
the MM is the fee payer.

accounts.name: market_maker
docs: Fee payer, rent payer, co-signer, and source of MM collateral and yield.

accounts.name: position_usdc_vault
docs: Holds the USDC leg of the position until settlement.

accounts.name: user_usdc_ata
docs: Created by the market maker if the user has no USDC account yet, so that
settlement can always pay the user in USDC.

instructions.name: override_asset_settlement_price
docs: 3/5 governance: set or replace a listed asset's settlement price.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent if the poster never posted. Governance signers go in `remaining_accounts`.

instructions.name: override_settlement_price
docs: 3/5 governance: set or replace the settlement price with no dispute window.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent if the poster never posted. Governance signers go in `remaining_accounts`.

instructions.name: post_asset_settlement_price
docs: Price poster records a listed asset's settlement price for an expiry.

accounts.name: settlement_price
docs: One price per (asset, expiry). `init` makes a second post fail.

instructions.name: post_settlement_price
docs: Price poster records the Deribit delivery price for (token, expiry).

accounts.name: settlement_price
docs: One price per (token, expiry). `init` makes a second post fail.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Permissionless settlement after expiry and the dispute window.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone. Pays the fee and, if needed, rent for missing USDC accounts.

accounts.name: settlement_price
docs: `SettlementPriceMissing` instead of a generic Anchor error.

accounts.name: position_usdc_vault
docs: USDC associated token account, so a settled position whose vault was closed
reports `AlreadySettled` rather than a deserialization error.

instructions.name: settle_asset_position
docs: Permissionless settlement of a listed-asset position.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Pays the fee and, if needed, rent for missing token accounts.

accounts.name: settlement_price
docs: `SettlementPriceMissing` instead of a generic Anchor error.

accounts.name: position_asset_vault
docs: after the `settled` guard.

errors.name: ExpiryInPast
errors.msg: Expiry must be in the future

errors.name: ExpiryNotAligned
errors.msg: Expiry must be exactly 08:00 UTC (Deribit delivery time)

errors.name: InvalidFixedPrice
errors.msg: Fixed price must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidYield
errors.msg: Yield must be greater than zero

errors.name: SameCounterparty
errors.msg: User and market maker must be different accounts

errors.name: InvalidTokenAccount
errors.msg: Token account does not match the expected mint or owner

errors.name: InvalidUsdcMint
errors.msg: USDC mint does not match GlobalConfig

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: NotExpiredYet
errors.msg: Position has not expired yet

errors.name: SettlementPriceMissing
errors.msg: No settlement price has been posted for this expiry

errors.name: SettlementPriceMismatch
errors.msg: Settlement price account does not match the expected PDA

errors.name: DisputeWindowOpen
errors.msg: Dispute window is still open for the posted settlement price

errors.name: AlreadySettled
errors.msg: Position is already settled

errors.name: UnauthorizedPricePoster
errors.msg: Only the configured price poster may post settlement prices

errors.name: InsufficientGovernanceSignatures
errors.msg: Fewer than the required number of governance keys signed

errors.name: UnauthorizedGovernanceSigner
errors.msg: A signer is not one of the governance keys

errors.name: DuplicateGovernanceKey
errors.msg: Governance keys must be distinct

errors.name: InvalidVault
errors.msg: Position vault does not belong to this position

errors.name: InvalidCounterparty
errors.msg: Account does not match the position's user or market maker

errors.name: InvalidSymbol
errors.msg: Asset symbol must be 1-16 printable ASCII characters

errors.name: InvalidExpiryTimeOfDay
errors.msg: Expiry time of day must be within [0, 86400) seconds

errors.name: AssetIsUsdc
errors.msg: USDC cannot be listed as an asset

types.name: AssetConfig
docs: An SPL token the program can settle besides SOL, listed by governance. Its
positions pair the token with USDC exactly as SOL positions do; `Product::SellSol`
means "sell the asset" and `Product::BuySol` "buy the asset" for these.

fields.name: symbol
docs: The symbol the desk and frontend use, e.g. "NVDAon".

fields.name: decimals
docs: Copied from the mint at listing.

fields.name: expiry_time_of_day
docs: Seconds after 00:00 UTC every expiry must land on: 08:00 for assets priced off
Deribit, 20:00 for US equities (the 16:00 New York close).

types.name: AssetPosition
docs: A position on a listed asset. Both legs are SPL tokens held in the position's
associated token accounts: `asset_mint` and USDC.

fields.name: product
docs: SellSol: the user locks the asset. BuySol: the user locks USDC.

fields.name: fixed_price
docs: USDC base units per whole asset token.

fields.name: expiry_ts
docs: Aligned to the asset's `expiry_time_of_day`.

fields.name: user_collateral
docs: User collateral: asset base units (SellSol) or USDC (BuySol).

fields.name: mm_collateral
docs: The other leg, posted by the market maker: USDC (SellSol) or asset (BuySol).

fields.name: yield_amount
docs: Paid to the user upfront in the collateral token.

types.name: AssetSettlementPrice
docs: Settlement price for a listed asset at one expiry.

fields.name: price
docs: USDC base units per whole token.

fields.name: governance_keys
docs: 3/5 multisig authority list.

fields.name: required_signatures
docs: Always 3.

fields.name: price_poster
docs: Key allowed to post Deribit delivery prices.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint accepted as Buy SOL collateral and as the Sell SOL payment leg.

fields.name: expiry_time_of_day
docs: Seconds after 00:00 UTC that every expiry of this asset lands on.

fields.name: fixed_price
docs: USDC base units per SOL.

fields.name: expiry_ts
docs: Must be 08:00 UTC on a future date.

fields.name: amount
docs: User collateral in base units of the product's collateral token.

fields.name: yield_amount
docs: Yield paid upfront to the user, in the same token as the collateral.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Random per-quote value; part of the PDA seed so a quote can only be used once.

fields.name: token
docs: Token the user locked as collateral.

fields.name: fixed_price
docs: USDC base units per SOL.

fields.name: expiry_ts
docs: Unix timestamp, must be 08:00 UTC.

fields.name: user_collateral
docs: User collateral in base units of `token`. SOL lamports live on this account;
USDC lives in the position's vault token account.

fields.name: mm_collateral
docs: The other leg of the exchange, posted by the market maker: USDC for Sell SOL,
SOL lamports for Buy SOL.

fields.name: yield_amount
docs: Paid to the user upfront in `token` base units.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Replay protection; part of the PDA seed.

fields.name: token
docs: Asset that was priced (SOL for every v1 product).

fields.name: expiry_ts
docs: 08:00 UTC on the expiry date.

fields.name: price
docs: USDC base units per token; the Deribit delivery price.

fields.name: posted_ts
docs: When the price was posted; the dispute window starts here.

fields.name: approvals
docs: Governance override approvals, indexed like `GlobalConfig.governance_keys`.
